phrases.note: Conflict: nói thẳng đã không đồng ý.

example.en: I disagreed with shipping without a flag.
example.vi: Mình không đồng ý ship khi chưa có flag.

phrases.note: STAR A: nói risk, không cá nhân.

example.en: I stated the risk of a bad deploy on Friday.
example.vi: Mình nêu risk deploy thứ Sáu.

example.en: We aligned on a flag and a Monday ship.
example.vi: Thống nhất flag và ship thứ Hai.

example.en: I pushed back because we had no rollback.
example.vi: Push back vì chưa có rollback.

example.en: In the end we delayed one day and it was fine.
example.vi: Cuối cùng delay một ngày, ổn.

pattern.title: Disagree without a fight
pattern.pattern: I disagreed → I stated the risk → I pushed back because… → We aligned on… / In the end we…
pattern.explainVi: Conflict: không đồng ý, nêu risk, push back vì lý do kỹ thuật, thống nhất. Không I won.

aiPrompt.scenario: Behavioral: a REAL disagreement at work. Interrupt 'what did you actually say?'. No I won.
aiPrompt.system: You are a software interviewer at a foreign company. Speak natural interview English. Keep each turn to 1–2 short sentences. You MAY use extra interview English so the learner practices listening. Interrupt with a follow-up. Nudge the learner to use these phrases: I disagreed; I stated the risk; We aligned on…; I pushed back because…; In the end we…. Ask about their real experience. Wait for the learner to reply.
